title: feat(components): element:text takes the published nine `variant` values (objectui#7450)
body:
Fixes #7450
Clause-②: yes

`element:text` converges on the published `TextSchema.variant` nine (`h1`-`h6`, `body`, `caption`, `overline`). This is the objectui half of ruling B (card comment 5565743592, maintainer 「其他同意」), on the released `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 pin that the routing (5599600566, two releases) waits for. Dev seat: `domain:ui#1`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`.

Note on spelling: GitHub strips tag-shaped text from bodies, so HTML elements are written as words below ("an h2 element", "a p element").

## What moved, face by face

| face | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| renderer element map (`elements.tsx`) | heading: h2 element; subheading: h3 element; anything else: p element | h1-h6: the heading element they name. body, caption, overline: p element. heading: h2, subheading: h3 (unchanged) |
| renderer classes | four entries | each of the nine takes `ui:text`'s class for that value. heading and subheading keep their old classes |
| inline read type | the four literals | `TextSchema['variant']` (the nine) plus the two spellings the contract still accepts |
| registry `inputs` enum | heading, subheading, body, caption | the nine first, then heading and subheading. This is the installed contract's eleven, member for member. Adds a `description` that names the nine as the values to write |
| Studio inspector options (`block-config.ts`) and the en/zh rows (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) | Heading, Subheading, Body, Caption | the nine (Heading 1 to Heading 6, Body, Caption, Overline). heading and subheading are no longer offered, and their two label rows are removed |
| the one in-repo producer (`apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts`) | `variant: 'subheading'` | `variant: 'h3'`, and the sample's prose is corrected |
| refusal prose (`packages/types/src/zod/public-blocks.zod.ts`, a declared cross-lane surface) | "a heading, subheading or paragraph" | "the heading level (`h1`-`h6`) or the paragraph style (`body`, `caption`, `overline`)" |

`ui:text` (`text.tsx`) is not changed. Its objectui#6942 rule stands: it does not synthesise `body` when `variant` is absent. objectui adds no local refusal, refinement or retirement mechanism.

## Zone 2 readings, measured before building

**1. What the installed spec accepts.** Probe: `ElementTextPropsSchema.safeParse` from the installed `node_modules/@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0.
- Accepted: `h1` to `h6`, `body`, `caption`, `overline`, `heading`, `subheading`.
- Refused with `invalid_value`: `title`, `display`, `bogus`. This is the firing control.
- An absent `variant` parses to `variant: 'body'`, because the spec declares `.default('body')`.

So the second case of Zone 2.2 holds. The spec still accepts `heading` and `subheading`, so the renderer keeps rendering them the way it always did, and the offering faces stop offering them. objectstack#17109's mechanism shipped, but it has not been applied to these two values.

**2. Falsified in part: the registry `inputs` enum is not an offer-only face.**
- `page.tsx` builds the html tier's JSX manifest from the registry `inputs`. An `invalid-enum` error there fails the whole page.
- The same `inputs` feed the published `sdui.manifest.json`, which the objectstack CLI's JSX gate reads.
- So dropping `heading` and `subheading` from that enum would make objectui refuse two values the spec accepts. That is a retirement ahead of the spec's, and the order forbids it.

Ablation A1 (below) measures this. Without the pair, the html tier refuses `variant="heading"`, and `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` stays green, because it judges widening only.

The resolution: the registry enum equals the contract's set, and the new pin asserts that equality. Its `description` points authors to the nine. The Studio inspector, which only offers values, offers just the nine.

Measured on `main` before this change: the html tier refused `h1`, `h4` to `h6` and `overline` on `element:text` with `invalid-enum`, which fails the page. The renderer drew all of `h1` to `h6` and `overline` as a body p element.

**3. The element map, with one deliberate deviation from the literal reading.**
- `h1` to `h6` render the heading element `ui:text` renders.
- All nine carry exactly `ui:text`'s class. The pin renders both renderers and compares them.
- `body`, `caption` and `overline` render a p element, not `ui:text`'s inline span. Two reasons:
  - `element:text` has always rendered a p element for its non-heading values. `body` and `caption` render byte-identically before and after this change.
  - Its `ALIGN_CLASS` has no `block`, so a span would leave `align` inert.

**4. The default.** An absent `variant` on `element:text` renders the same bytes as an authored `body`. This is pinned beside a `ui:text` control that still renders no element for the same input.

**5. Producer and riders.**
- `preview-samples.ts` moves `subheading` to `h3`. The sample's own prose says the original asked for `level: 3`.
- The `public-blocks.zod.ts` prose is corrected.
- Docs count: `content/docs/` documents `element:text` zero times. There is one incidental mention, in a CLI diagnostic sample in `utilities/cli.mdx` that lists type names. The control, `page:header`, appears in 3 files. No docs page is added, as the routing said.

## The migration is not one-to-one

The migration hint is `heading` to `h2` and `subheading` to `h3`, or the level the document means. The sizes do not carry over, though, because the legacy pair keeps its old classes:
- `heading` was text-2xl on an h2 element. That is `ui:text`'s `h3` size; `h2` is text-3xl.
- `subheading` was text-lg on an h3 element; `h3` is text-2xl.

The preview sample's "Quick links" heading therefore renders larger after moving to `h3`.

## Tests (final head `a0bc45d76e`, a merge of `origin/main` `d79f525d9e`)

All heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `issue-7450`).

**Build.** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console^...' run build`: exit 0. This closure contains components, types and app-shell.

**Type-check.** `pnpm --filter X run type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0 each.
- Coverage of the new tests was counted with `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly`, not assumed.
- components: 3 hits (both 7450 pins, plus the 6942 control).
- app-shell: 2 hits (the new pin, plus `block-config.test.ts`).

**Vitest.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` from the repo root: **472 files, 10178 tests passed**, exit 0. The set:
- `packages/types/`
- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`
- the PageBlockInspector suites
- the html-tier and sdui suites in apps/console
- `text-variant-align-6942.test.tsx`
- every suite that `git grep -l` finds for element:text, ElementTextRenderer, subheading, preview-samples or option.variant. This includes `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, `public-contract.test.ts` and the three preview-samples suites.

**Repo checks** (exit 0 each):
- `check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- `check-changeset-presence`: 8 source files in 4 released packages, 4 changesets.
- `changeset:check`.
- `check:i18n-keys`.
- `check:i18n-designer-parity`.
- `check:test-path-roots`.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only): it lists 8 pending changesets that name touched files. Each was re-read, and all are still true.
- `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only): no `element:text` row.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

**ESLint (narrowed).** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 8 changed TS/TSX files: 0 errors, 19 warnings, 0 files ignored.
- All 19 warnings are in `elements.tsx`, and they are the same set as the base blob linted through stdin: 12 no-explicit-any, 5 only-export-components, 1 set-state-in-effect, 1 exhaustive-deps.
- Why the narrowing is safe: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

**Ablations.** Each ran from the committed state through `ablation-replace.mjs`, under a trap. Every leg proved its write on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed) and its restore (blob equals HEAD blob `03740bf2`, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- **A1**: drop `heading` and `subheading` from the registry enum. The new pin goes red, 3 of 50: the accept-set equality test, and the html tier compiling `heading` and `subheading`. `registry-inputs-spec-parity` stays green, 230 of 230.
- **A1c** (control on the same path): widen the enum with `title`. The parity gate goes red ("element:text declares no arm the spec refuses outright"), which proves it reads the mutated source. Its green in A1 is therefore a real reading.
- **A2**: map `h1` to a p element. The pin goes red, 1 of 50 ("h1 renders the heading element it names").
- **A3b**: set `skipFallback` to `false` on element:text, which equals deleting it, because the guard reads `!meta?.skipFallback`. The bare-key pin goes red, 3 of 7, including the rewritten absence case.
  - The first A3 attempt was refused by the tool before any test ran: its replacement text already occurred, so it could not prove the write. It restored by blob equality and was re-run as A3b.

## Pins

- New: `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/element-text-published-variants-7450.test.tsx`. The nine are derived from the types mirror and the accept set from the spec. The one restated fact is the pre-convergence pair, which goes red, with instructions, when spec release 2 retires it.
- New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/element-text-variant-options-7450.test.ts`. It pins the inspector offer: the nine, in `ui:text` order, each accepted by the spec, labelled distinctly in en and zh.
- Rewritten: the last case of `text-bare-key-resolution-7450.test.tsx`. Once the vocabularies agree, `h1` no longer tells the two renderers apart. What `skipFallback` still protects is absence: under the flag, the unannotated `text` node renders no wrapper element, and the control shows `element:text` painting a body p element.

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- `text.tsx`'s docblock paragraph that begins "The two vocabularies are NOT reconciled here and must not be" is now stale. It still says `element:text` publishes heading, subheading, body and caption. I left it untouched under the order's "do not change ui:text". A comment-only fix could say: element:text converged on these nine by adopting this map (objectui#7450); this map is the vocabulary and does not move. Carrier: none.
- The inspector shows a stored legacy value through `InspectorSelectField`'s generic flag ("not found"). A "deprecated" flag would need per-field plumbing in `BlockPropField`. Carrier: none.
- In the preview sample, `h3` now renders at the same size as `page:header`'s bare-title h1 (both text-2xl). That comes from a mismatch between the `ui:text` heading ladder and `page:header`'s title size, and is polish. Carrier: none.
- `@object-ui/components` declares `@objectstack/spec` `^17.0.0`, but its offered enum matches 17.5.0's accept set. The validator, `@object-ui/types`, sets its floor at `^17.5.0`. `check-spec-range-floors` judges only whether symbols are present (objectui#9036). Noted, not changed.
- The header prose of `preview-samples-registry-resolvable.test.ts` still names `variant: 'heading'` (which renders an h2) as the nearest real thing. That is still true, so it was not edited.
- Changesets: `@object-ui/components` minor (Clause-② widening of the manifest enum), `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/types` patch (message text only), `@object-ui/console` patch.
